layout.guidance: Connect each live question to evidence and action through aligned bands while keeping the surrounding field quiet.

mobile.guidance: Stack decisions, evidence, and actions in source order with a labelled compact navigation trigger.

tablet.guidance: Collapse secondary navigation and place supporting evidence below the principal decision when needed.

desktop.guidance: Use the twelve column field for one live question, aligned proof, and a ranked next action.

zoom.guidance: Let navigation, labels, metrics, tables, and actions wrap or reflow without clipping.

reflow.guidance: Preserve complete source ordered bands and use labelled overflow only for irreducible data comparison.

compact.usage: Data cells, tags, and compact controls.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, menus, and ordinary interactions.

panel.usage: Cards, dialogs, and bounded working surfaces.

rail.usage: Pulse rails, table groups, and structural bands.

focus.usage: Focus, active selection, and consequential separation.

flat.usage: Default bands, data groups, and working surfaces.

overlay.usage: Dialogs and temporary content above the operational field.

buttons.guidance: Use one filled primary action per decision band and keep secondary actions defined, direct, and stable.

states.default: Use the cobalt primary with a result focused label.
states.hover: Deepen the primary without changing size or position.
states.focus: Show the semantic focus ring outside the control boundary.
states.active: Compress by at most one pixel without shifting nearby content.
states.disabled: Keep the action readable and expose the unmet prerequisite.
states.loading: Retain the action label beside a visible progress indicator.
states.success: Name the completed outcome with text and the success role.
states.error: Name the failed operation and its recovery with destructive semantics.

links.guidance: Use specific destinations, persistent prose underlines, and an explicit current navigation state.

states.default: Underline prose destinations and use the accessible primary role.
states.hover: Strengthen the underline without changing line height.
states.focus: Frame the link with the same semantic focus ring as controls.
states.active: Preserve the destination while showing immediate activation.
states.disabled: Render unavailable destinations as explained text rather than links.
states.loading: Keep the destination label and add adjacent busy status.
states.success: Confirm the local navigation result in nearby text.
states.error: Explain the local failure and recovery without relying on color.

forms.guidance: Group fields by decision, keep help persistent, and place validation in the same reading path.
forms.help: The selected team receives new incidents from this service.
forms.error: Choose a team with an active response schedule.
forms.success: The incident route is valid and ready to save.

inputs.textareaPlaceholder: Describe the condition and expected response.
inputs.guidance: Keep labels visible, align fields to the decision band, and reserve stable space for help and validation.

cards.title: Response window
cards.description: A bounded task connects current health, ownership, freshness, and the next valid response.
cards.guidance: Use a card for one independent task or proof set, not merely to add a border.

panels.title: Live activity register
panels.description: The register aligns current health, unresolved work, and verified outcomes in one readable band.
panels.guidance: Use one pulse rail and shared alignment instead of separate containers for every value.

navigation.label: Operations sections
navigation.guidance: Name the current section in text, preserve source order, and keep every destination keyboard reachable.

listItems.title: Healthy
listItems.description: Fourteen services are within their response target.

listItems.title: Investigating
listItems.description: One event stream has delayed processing.

listItems.title: Recovered
listItems.description: Billing sync returned to normal throughput.

dataDisplay.guidance: Keep service, state, owner, freshness, and action aligned with tabular numerals and explicit labels.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: Preserve complete comparison in a labelled keyboard reachable scroll region when priority columns cannot fit.

badges.label: Investigating
badges.meaning: A named owner is examining the condition

badges.label: Healthy
badges.meaning: The service meets its verified operating target

badges.label: Attention
badges.meaning: A condition needs review before failure

badges.label: Unavailable
badges.meaning: A failed requirement blocks the service

alerts.title: Event stream needs investigation
alerts.description: Processing delay exceeded the response target five minutes ago.

alerts.title: Billing sync recovered
alerts.description: Throughput returned to the verified range and monitoring continues.

alerts.title: Activity history unavailable
alerts.description: Existing service status remains visible while history reconnects.

states.loading: Refreshing service states without hiding the last verified state.
states.empty: No services are connected to this operations view yet.
states.filteredEmpty: No services match the active state and owner filters.
states.error: Activity history could not refresh. The last verified state remains available.
states.success: The response route is verified and active.
states.disabled: Escalation remains unavailable until an active response team is assigned.
states.destructive: Removing this service also removes its unresolved local activity history.

feedback.guidance: Attach state to the affected service, preserve useful context, and include the next valid recovery.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Pair every status color with a label, icon, boundary, or explicit state text.

dialogs.title: Confirm response route
dialogs.description: Review the service, owner, schedule, and escalation target before activation.
dialogs.guidance: Keep the route summary concise, place safe review first, and preserve the originating service context.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes the dialog because activation occurs only after explicit confirmation.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the route control that opened the dialog.

destructiveActions.consequence: Unresolved local activity history and routing preferences will be removed.
destructiveActions.recoverability: This preview action is reversible and changes only local specimen state.
destructiveActions.guidance: Repeat the service name, scope, consequence, and true recovery status before the destructive boundary.

motion.guidance: Use short motion for response and continuity, allow pulse cells to fill only after action, and never add ambient loops.

reducedMotion.guidance: Remove translation, scaling, smooth scrolling, sequential fills, and loops while preserving immediate labelled state changes.

accessibility.semantics: Use native landmarks, headings, controls, forms, tables, lists, dialogs, and status regions before adding ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Keep navigation, menus, filters, sorting, selection, overflow regions, row actions, and dialogs operable in logical source order.
accessibility.focus: Use a persistent two pixel focus indicator in light, dark, and forced colors modes and restore focus after modal interaction.
accessibility.contrast: Measure text, controls, borders, status, meaningful graphics, and focus across both supported color schemes.
accessibility.targetSize: Provide targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels with adequate spacing and prefer 44 pixels for important touch actions.
accessibility.zoom: Preserve every navigation item, metric, label, table control, and action at 200 percent page zoom and 400 percent browser zoom.
accessibility.reflow: Reflow operational bands to 320 CSS pixels without two dimensional page scrolling.
accessibility.forcedColors: Retain pulse structure, current selection, focus, boundaries, and feedback when system colors replace authored colors.
accessibility.statusCommunication: Announce asynchronous outcomes intentionally and never rely on color, position, shape, icon, or motion alone.

productSurfaces.guidance: These specimens demonstrate Pulsegrid structure only. Replace illustrative words with supplied Project language and preserve every real workflow rule.
